jobs.occupation: Project Manager - Process Management Hire to Retire (H2R) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Boehringer Ingelheim Pharma GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com
The Position
Are you ready to drive impactful change in a dynamic environment? As Project Manager - PPM H2R, you will shape organizational structures, methods, and digital governance across all GBS Process Management Hire to Retire towers, ensuring optimal activity distribution.
You will act as a trusted advisor to stakeholders, strengthening delivery and process excellence while maintaining strong project governance. In this collaborative role, you will contribute to the success of strategic GBS initiatives and play a key part in transforming processes for the future.
Tasks & responsibilities

- You will lead strategic, tactical, and organizational priority projects across GBS PM H2R, with a strong focus on Payroll and Time management.
- By promoting agile ways of working, such as Scrum and Lean methodologies, you will actively support the transformation toward a more agile GBS organization.
- You will establish PMO standards, methods, and governance frameworks to ensure consistent project execution across GBS PM H2R, following the official project framework (GBS united).
- Through continuous improvement initiatives, you will optimize end-to-end GBS processes, ensuring efficiency, standardization, and scalability.
- To strengthen operational excellence, you will define and implement process frameworks, workflows, and governance models that align with organizational goals.
- Your role will include supporting the assessment and preparation of decision papers and value cases, enabling informed and impactful decision-making.

Requirements

- Master's or diploma degree in Information Management, Computer Science, Business Administration or Industrial Engineering
- Solid GBS and Payroll & Time knowledge (processes, operating model, governance, methodologies) and ability to drive innovation and organizational change
- Highly motivated team player with strong analytical and conceptual skills, able to thrive in international, cross functional settings
- Proven consulting and project management experience (agile and traditional, e.g., Scrum Master, Agile Coach) is a plus
- Capability to deep dive into collaborative working models and IT tools, and translate insights effectively into the GBS environment
- Excellent communication, leadership, and influencing skills, with strong English proficiency

As part of our commitment to transparency and fairness, salary information will be shared during the recruitment process. We also offer a comprehensive benefits and wellbeing package. Applications from persons with severe disabilities are warmly welcomed. In cases of equal qualifications, such applicants will be given preferential consideration in the selection process.
Ready to contact us?
If you have any questions about the job posting or process - please contact our HR Direct Team, Tel: +49 (0) 6132 77-3330 or via mail: hr.de@boehringer-ingelheim.com

Step 1: Online application - The job posting is presumably online until September 8th, 2026. We reserve the right to take the posting offline beforehand. Applications up to August 25th, 2026 are guaranteed to be considered.
Step 2: Virtual meeting in the period from end of August till mid of September
Step 3: On-site interviews beginning Mid of September

Über die PositionAt Grolman, we connect people, products and markets around the world. As our Global Logistics Network Lead, you will increase supply chain efficiency and resilience by optimising our global warehousing and freight network while advancing automation and digitalisation across logistics operations. By reducing costs and CO₂ emissions and enhancing customer and supplier service levels, you will help shape a smarter and more sustainable global supply chain.
Your mission
• Develop and drive Grolman’s global logistics network strategy and roadmap across warehousing and freight
• Analyse global goods flows and optimise warehousing and freight concepts
• Build and develop strategic partnerships with warehouse providers and freight forwarders
• Drive digitalisation, automation, transparency and benchmarking across logistics operations and partners
• Develop KPIs and performance management systems to improve logistics cost efficiency and customer & supplier service levels
• Lead international logistics optimisation and transformation projects
• Develop sustainable logistics concepts, including CO₂ reporting and green logistics offerings

Your profile
• 5+ years of experience in logistics network design, warehousing and freight optimisation within an international environment
• Strong analytical skills with experience in supply chain optimisation and logistics digitalisation
• Proven project and stakeholder management skills in cross-functional and international teams
• Customer-focused, entrepreneurial, hands-on and self-driven with a collaborative mindset
• Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to build lasting business relationships
• Passion for sustainable logistics and balancing customer service, cost efficiency and CO₂ reduction
• Experience in chemical or B2B distribution is an advantage
• Very good English skills and confident use of Microsoft 365, Excel and Power BI

Why us?Why us?We are shaping the future of circular innovation with the vision:“We sell chemicals to save the planet.”You can expect a friendly, self-organized, and international working environment with flat hierarchies and teams that take full ownership and responsibility. We believe that commitment and enjoyment at work lead to outstanding performance. Trust, mutual respect, and loyalty form the foundation of our collaboration.We communicate openly, act authentically, and continuously reinvent ourselves – optimistically, entrepreneurially, and always on equal footing. Let’s Grow New together.
Benefits
• Flexibility in working hours and location
• Internal coaching & training
• Collaboration in a Self-Organised Environment
• Direct impact on the Group’s sustainability and circularity strategy
• Remote-based in any EU country where Grolman Group operates

Salary information in line with EU Pay Transparency requirements: Austria: Gross annual base salary of €68,000–€80,000, with readiness to pay above the applicable collective-agreement minimum
Italy: Gross annual base salary of €55,000–€68,000.
Other eligible EU countries: The applicable salary range will be shared before the first interview.

About usWe are an international specialty chemicals distribution company that has been privately owned and managed by the fifth generation of the Grolman family since 1855. The key to our success has always been our strong commitment and dedication to building an efficient, customer-oriented organization in which the needs of our customers are the main driving force.Our vision is: “We want to sell chemicals to save the planet.” For us, this means promoting innovation towards a circular economy. We achieve this through a strong focus on close personal relationships and the development of our own employees.

InfoWho we areWe are the tech powerhouse behind Kaufland’s international online marketplaces and a company within the Schwarz Group. Driven by a start-up mentality and working on an equal footing within flat hierarchies, we develop the best marketplace solutions for our customers, sellers and partners. #FromEuropeForEurope

Day by day, our Tech & Product Team of about 400 experts pursues the goal of creating the best possible customer shopping experience for our online marketplace. Through innovative technical developments, they not only create an outstanding shopping experience but also lay the foundation for an optimal selling experience for our sellers. Learn more about our division, areas, and cross-functional teams here!

AufgabenYour tasks – this is what awaits you in detail
• As a Senior Search Engineer (all genders) - Elasticsearch your goal is to bring our search to the next level for our customers
• Improving our relevance: Writing faster queries, improving data quality of ingested data and by making decisions on better vs. worse relevancy - you understand our searches inside out to make and share informed decisions
• Enriching our ingestion architecture: Consuming change events, updating Elasticsearch mappings and indexing into new fields, ensuring we are able to index into a single document from multiple sources
• Efficient integration: We are not alone in a huge stack like this - this can be enhanced by better mapping, faster retrieval of recently changed data or adding a field, so we can boost our searches more efficiently
• Data modelling: Understanding its implications and effects on indexing and querying
• Performance enhancement: You are always on the lookout, keeping our search speed as fast as possible
• Safety first: With everything you touch and design, you keep resiliency in mind as a key theme in a microservice environment. You know what circuit breakers and bulk heads are and only use caches when they make sense. You favour exponential backoff over CrashLoopBackoff - a lot!
• Our team tech stack consists of Kubernetes, gRPC, Typescript, the latest Node.js major version, Elasticsearch, a bit of MongoDB, Kafka and last but not least, we are using DataDog for monitoring

ProfilYour profile – this is what we expect from you
• You have relevant experience of 7+ years as a Search Engineer
• You know how a (distributed) search engine works and have gained experience with one of the more well known search engines in the market
• You bring the skills to run, monitor, debug, and operate our Elasticsearch cluster and applications and always write well tested and reviewed code
• You don't believe, you know: You do not guess and are well equipped with tangible facts and figures, we run A/B tests for validation and expect you to come up with proper metrics of success and failure for a search feature
• You are curious about the latest developments in tech and the search space in general (semantic search, NLP, LLMs, vectors, hybrid search, machine learning are all on our roadmap, especially with performance in mind)
• We're a team and do not appreciate a bus factor of 1: You have the desire to help others, share your knowledge and mentor others
• You are willing to go the extra mile to make your team successful, you give honest feedback, able to discuss, commit and execute
• You have excellent written and spoken English skills

BenefitsWhat we offer
• Create your own work-life balance: You have the flexibility to choose between working remotely (within Germany) or from one of our locations in Cologne, Darmstadt, Düsseldorf, or in Berlin!
• Urban Sports Club and RSG Group Fitness Studios : Get top deals for fitness, swimming, yoga and more
• Mental Well-Being: We support you on your well-being journey with special offerings such as Instahelp, the digital platform for online psychological counseling
• Vacation & Sabbatical: Enjoy 30 days of vacation per year and the opportunity to take a sabbatical once you have been part of the team for a certain period!
• Option for Pluxee restaurant vouchers : Buy Pluxee vouchers through us and benefit from tax-advantaged meal allowances!
• ‘ Deutschlandticket’: We subsidize your train season ticket for more mobility
• Employee Discount: You will receive a monthly coupon for Kaufland.de
• Free choice of hardware: Mac or Lenovo, it's up to you
• Boost your growth: Benefit from our online language learning programs, diverse in-house training, and our automated 360-degree feedback
• This is who we are: Our dynamic culture combines flat hierarchies, a start-up mentality, an international team of over 65 nationalities, and the strength of the Schwarz Group to provide you an agile and secure working environment.
• We are team players : From day one, you will connect not only with your team but also with others through our digital onboarding journey, the buddy program, and regular team and company events, all-hands meetings, powerful mornings, and much more!

Check out our Principles & our blog for even more insights into our company culture!
BewerbenDiversity at Kaufland e-commerceWe welcome applications from everyone, regardless of skin colour, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, ethnic origin, religion and ideology. We are signatories to the Charta der Vielfalt (German Diversity Charter) – because we know that extraordinary things can only be achieved with diversity. Read more here! When applying, you can optionally include your pronouns in your resume.

• You communicate clearly and effectively, know how to create alignment, and understand what matters, especially in a remote and distributed setup

OUR COMPANY

Boehringer Ingelheim is a biopharmaceutical company active in both human and animal health. As one of the industry's top investors in research and development, the company focuses on developing innovative therapies that can improve and extend lives in areas of high unmet medical need. Independent since its foundation in 1885, Boehringer takes a long-term perspective, embedding sustainability along the entire value chain. Our approximately 54,500 employees serve over 130 markets to build a healthier and more sustainable tomorrow. Learn more at www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

Tasks & responsibilities

- In this role, you will leverage your extensive legal expertise to mitigate launch risks from third party patents for our newly developed products as well as to enforce and defend our patents to defend our products against patent infringement.
- With a strategic mindset, you will develop complex launch risk mitigation strategies in a cross functional set up and provide tailored advice to the business how to leverage upside potential from our existing patent portfolios.
- Managing and instructing our network of external lawyers and patent attorneys in disputes including in-court infringement and nullity proceedings will be a key part of your responsibilities.
- In addition, you will support the negotiation and drafting of complex agreements to find the best possible solutions for Boehringer Ingelheim.

Requirements

- Fully qualified lawyer, preferably with honors in the second state examination. An additional qualification (LL.M. or comparable degree with a focus on IP law) is desirable
- Longterm specialization in the field of intellectual property and the pharmaceutical industry at an international level as well as extensive experience in managing large international IP portfolios
- Longterm relevant professional experience in external law firms specialized on patent litigation or in a comparable in-house position as a corporate counsel
- Experience in leading, coordinating, and managing patent litigation
- Knowledge and experience in the pharmaceutical industry
- Strong strategic understanding and the ability to quickly grasp and clearly present legally and technically complex matters
- High level of teamwork and excellent communication skills in English and German

What we offer

With us, you can develop your own path in a company with a culture that knows our differences are our strengths - and break new ground in the drive to make millions of lives better.

Here, your development is our priority. Supporting you to build a career as part of a workplace that is independent, authentic and bold, while tackling challenging work in a respectful and friendly environment where everyone is valued and welcomed.

Alongside, you have access to programs and groups that ensure your health and wellbeing are looked after - as we make major investments to drive global accessibility to healthcare. By being part of a team that is constantly innovating, you'll be helping to transform lives for generations.

Want to learn more? Visit https://www.boehringer-ingelheim.com

jobs.description:
Are you passionate about interdisciplinary research and eager to contribute to groundbreaking discoveries in the areas of biochemistry, structural biology, biophysics, cell biology, chemical biology and synthetic biology?

The International Max Planck Research School for Living Matter: from molecules to dynamics (IMPRS-LM) is a joint PhD program between the Max Planck Institute of Molecular Physiology, the TU Dortmund University, the Ruhr University of Bochum, and the University of Duisburg-Essen, located in the vibrant and multicultural Ruhr Metropolitan Area in Germany. The IMPRS-LM unites scientists from diverse disciplines to tackle a fundamental question in biology: How chemical components organize into the complex, dynamic systems we recognize as living cells? By combining experimental, theoretical, and computational approaches, our interdisciplinary team of molecular biologists, chemists and physicists explores the spatial and temporal dynamics of biochemical networks within the cellular environment. We welcome applicants with a Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Biology, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, (Bio-)Physics, Chemistry, Computer Science, or related fields. The IMPRS-LM offers a unique, internationally recognized PhD training program designed to equip students with the interdisciplinary expertise needed to address complex challenges in cellular biology. Through a rigorous curriculum, hands-on research in world-class labs, and personalized mentorship, we empower students to become innovative, independent researchers ready to shape the future of science.

As a PhD student, you will benefit from:

Fully funded positions (via employment contracts with full social benefits)
Dedicated mentors who support your scientific and career development
An inclusive, international research community fostering collaboration and creativity
Access to state-of-the-art facilities and advanced technologies
A fully English-speaking program featuring lectures, advanced workshops, transferable skills training, and career development activities

Visit the IMPRS-LM website for more information about the program requirements, the application process, and the list of research group leaders currently offering positions.

The Max Planck Society is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace, providing equal opportunities to all employees, irrespective of gender, nationality, disabilities, religious or personal orientation. We strongly encourage applications from underrepresented groups.

The Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, with its tradition spanning more than 600 years, is one of the largest research institutions in the Leipzig region. With over 1,300 employees, it is the largest of the university's 14 faculties and serves as a training center for approximately 3,500 students in human medicine, dentistry, pharmacy, and midwifery.

We are seeking a highly motivated Epidemiologist to design and conduct epidemiological research in pediatric populations, focusing on the determinants of child health, the development of common childhood diseases, particularly obesity, and the prevention and long-term outcomes of childhood obesity and metabolic diseases.
The research group "Childhood Obesity and Metabolic Research", led by Antje Körner, investigates the development, mechanisms and health consequences of childhood obesity. The translational approach combines experimental research, clinical studies and genetic approaches. Our international and interdisciplinary team is closely integrated with the research structures of the Medical Faculty of Leipzig University, Helmholtz Munich, and leading local as well as national research consortia, such as the Excellence cluster LeiCeM, the German Center for Child and Youth Health (DZKJ), and our large children's and adolescents' cohort LIFE Child.
We have large, well-characterized cohorts up and running with a longitudinal setting and across the entire age range: LIFE Child (n~6000), Leipzig Obesity Childhood Cohort (n~2500), and Leipzig Adipose Tissue Childhood cohort (n~700), with deep phenotyping allowing for combining clinical, epidemiological, lifestyle and functional omics and multi-omics data.
Key Responsibilities

- Design, plan, and conduct epidemiological research projects, including cohort and intervention studies.
- Develop study protocols and statistical analysis plans.
- Analyze and interpret complex population-based, clinical, and/or health-related datasets.
- Preparation of scientific manuscripts, reports, presentations, and grant applications.
- Ensure high standards of data quality, reproducibility, and compliance with ethical and data protection regulations.
- Present research findings at national and international conferences and scientific meetings.
- Provide methodological expertise and consultation to ongoing research projects; collaborate closely with clinicians, statisticians, bioinformaticians, and other researchers
- Supervision junior researchers or students.

Required Qualifications
Education: Candidates should have a Ph.D. and/or M.D. degree in: Epidemiology, Public Health, Biostatistics, Medicine, Health Sciences or a related discipline.
Professional Experience

- Experience in the design and implementation of epidemiological studies, large cohort studies.
- Experience working with large-scale health, clinical, or population-based datasets.
- Strong understanding of epidemiological study designs and methodologies.
- Experience with observational and interventional research.
- Experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance.
- Familiarity with evidence-based medicine and public health principles.
- Track record of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals is desirable.
- Experience in interdisciplinary and collaborative research environments.
- Knowledge of research ethics and data protection requirements.
- Experience in grant writing is an advantage.
- Knowledge of causal inference methods (e.g., Target Trial Emulation, Mendelian Randomization) is desirable.

Statistical and Analytical Skills

- Proficiency in at least one statistical programming language such as: R, SAS, Stata, Python.
- Experience with general statistical methods:
- Regression modeling
- Longitudinal data analysis
- Missing data methods
- Sensitivity analyses
- Knowledge of modern analytical approaches, including machine learning methods, is an advantage.

Personal Competencies

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent organizational and project management abilities.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively in multidisciplinary teams.
- Communication skills: English - excellent; German - very good

Candidates with one or more of the following areas of expertise are particularly encouraged to apply:

- Cohort studies
- Precision medicine and risk prediction modeling
- Multi-omics, biomarker, or biobank data integration
- Obesity, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, or metabolic health research
